s.en: execute new process inside the container

syn: runc exec [option ...] container-id [--] command [arg ...] ⏎ runc exec [option ...] -p process.json container-id

o.en: Path to an AF_UNIX socket which will receive a file descriptor referencing the master end of the console's pseudoterminal. See docs/terminals ⟨https://github.com/opencontainers/runc/blob/master/docs/terminals.md⟩.

Change to path in the container before executing the command. Set an environment variable name to value. Can be specified multiple times. Allocate a pseudo-TTY. Run the command as a user (and, optionally, group) specified by uid (and gid). Add additional group IDs. Can be specified multiple times.
Specify the file to write the container process' PID to.
Set the asm process label for the process commonly used with selinux(7).
Set the apparmor(7) profile for the process.
Set the "no new privileges" value for the process.
Add a capability to the bounding set for the process. Can be specified multiple times.
Pass N additional file descriptors to the container (stdio + $LISTEN_FDS + N in total). Default is 0.
Allow exec in a paused container. By default, if a container is paused, runc exec errors out; this option can be used to override it. A paused container needs to be resumed for the exec to complete.
Execute a process in a sub-cgroup. If the specified cgroup does not exist, an error is returned. Default is empty path, which means to use container's top level cgroup.
